title.zh: 卷二十二 本紀第二十二 熹宗
title.raw: 卷二十二 本紀第二十二 熹宗 Volume 22 Annals 22: Xizong

sentences.zh: 熹宗，達天闡道敦孝篤友章文襄武靖穆莊勤悊皇帝，諱由校，光宗長子也。

translations.literal: Xizong, the Emperor of Reaching Heaven, Expounding the Way, Deep in Filial Piety, Sincere in Friendship, Manifest in Culture, Supporting in Martial Accomplishment, Tranquil and Solemn, Diligent and Reverent, taboo name Youjiao, was Guangzong's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xizong—honored after death as one who reached Heaven, expounded the Way, and united deep filial piety, sincere friendship, manifest culture, supporting martial accomplishment, tranquil solemnity, and diligent reverence—was named Zhu Youjiao and was the eldest son of Emperor Guangzong.

sentences.zh: 母選侍王氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Attendant Wang.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Attendant Wang of the Wang clan.

sentences.zh: 萬曆三十三年十一月，神宗以元孫生，詔告天下。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of Wanli thirty-three, Shenzong, because the eldest grandchild was born, proclaimed it to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Wanli thirty-three, upon the birth of his eldest grandchild, Shenzong issued an edict announcing it throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，神宗遺詔皇長孫及時冊立，未及行。

translations.literal: In year forty-eight, Shenzong's final edict ordered that the eldest imperial grandson be invested as heir apparent in timely fashion; it was not carried out in time.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli forty-eight Shenzong's deathbed edict ordered that the eldest imperial grandson be invested as heir apparent without delay, but the measure was not carried out before his death.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，光宗崩，遺詔皇長子嗣皇帝位。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yihai: Guangzong died; his final edict ordered the eldest imperial son to succeed to the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yihai, Guangzong died; his deathbed edict installed the eldest imperial son as emperor.

sentences.zh: 群臣哭臨畢，請見皇長子於寢門，奉至文華殿行禮，還居慈慶宮。

translations.literal: When the assembled ministers had finished mourning attendance, they requested to see the eldest imperial son at the bedchamber gate; he was escorted to the Wenhua Hall to perform the rites, then returned to reside at the Ciqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: After the ministers had finished mourning attendance, they asked to see the eldest imperial son at the bedchamber gate, escorted him to the Wenhua Hall to perform the rites, and then returned him to the Ciqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙子，頒遺詔。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the final edict was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the deathbed edict was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 時選侍李氏居乾清宮，吏部尚書周嘉謨等及御史左光斗疏請選侍移宮，御史王安舜疏論李可灼進藥之誤，「紅丸」、「移宮」二案自是起。

translations.literal: At the time Attendant Li dwelt in the Qianqing Palace; Minister of Personnel Zhou Jiamo and others and Censor Zuo Guangdou memorialized requesting that the Attendant move palace; Censor Wang Anshun memorialized on Li Kezhuo's error in presenting medicine—from this arose the two cases of the "Red Pill" and the "Palace Transfer."
translations.idiomatic: At the time Attendant Li still occupied the Qianqing Palace; Minister of Personnel Zhou Jiamo, Censor Zuo Guangdou, and others memorialized demanding that she move out, while Censor Wang Anshun memorialized on Li Kezhuo's error in administering medicine—thus arose the two controversies known as the Red Pill Case and the Palace Transfer Case.

sentences.zh: 己卯，選侍移仁壽殿。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the Attendant moved to the Renshou Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Attendant moved to the Renshou Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: he ascended the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 詔赦天下，以明年為天啟元年。

translations.literal: An edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm; the following year was made Tianqi year one.
translations.idiomatic: An edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm and declared the following year Tianqi one.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以是年八月以後稱泰昌元年。

translations.literal: Day jichou: from the eighth month of this year onward it was styled Taichang year one.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the court ruled that from the eighth month of that year onward the reign would be styled Taichang one.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，逮遼東總兵官李如柏。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Regional Commander Li Rubai of Liaodong was arrested.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Regional Commander Li Rubai of Liaodong was arrested.

sentences.zh: 甲午，廕太監魏進忠兄錦衣衛千戶。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the eunuch Wei Jinzhong's elder brother was granted inherited appointment as Battalion Commander in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the elder brother of the eunuch Wei Jinzhong was granted hereditary appointment as battalion commander in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

sentences.zh: 封乳保客氏為奉聖夫人，官其子。

translations.literal: Wet-nurse Ke Shi was enfeoffed as Lady Fengsheng; her son was given an office.
translations.idiomatic: The wet-nurse Ke Shi was enfeoffed as Lady Fengsheng, and her son was given an official post.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，葬顯皇帝、孝端顯皇后於定陵。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingwu: the Manifest Emperor and the Empress Xiaoduanxian were buried at Dingling.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingwu, Emperor Shenzong and Empress Xiaoduanxian were buried at Dingling.

sentences.zh: 戊申，遼東巡撫都御史袁應泰為兵部侍郎，經略遼東，代熊廷弼。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Yuan Yingtai, Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Liaodong, was made Vice Minister of War and commissioner-in-chief of Liaodong, replacing Xiong Tingbi.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Yuan Yingtai, grand coordinator of Liaodong, was made vice minister of war and put in charge of Liaodong affairs, replacing Xiong Tingbi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，御經筵。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: [the emperor] attended the Classics Lectern.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the emperor attended the Classics Lectern.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，禮部尚書孫如游兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Sun Ruyou, Minister of Rites, was also made Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and took part in confidential state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Sun Ruyou, minister of rites, was also made grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and admitted to confidential state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，噦鸞宮災。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the Huanyuan Palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Huanyuan Palace was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，追諡皇妣孝元貞皇后，生母孝和皇太后。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: posthumous titles were conferred on the imperial mother as Empress Xiaoyuanzhen and on the birth mother as Empress Dowager Xiaohe.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingzi, posthumous honors were granted to the imperial mother as Empress Xiaoyuanzhen and to his birth mother as Empress Dowager Xiaohe.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，方從哲致仕。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinyou: Fang Congzhe retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, Fang Congzhe retired from office.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年春正月庚辰，享太廟。

translations.literal: Tianqi year one, spring, first month, day gengchen: the imperial ancestors were sacrificed to at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianqi one, in the first month of spring, on gengchen, the emperor sacrificed to the imperial ancestors at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，追諡伍文定等七十三人。

translations.literal: Day renchen: posthumous titles were conferred on Wu Wending and seventy-two others.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen posthumous honors were granted to Wu Wending and seventy-two others.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，御史王心一請罷客氏香火土田，魏進忠陵工敘錄，不報。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Censor Wang Xinyi requested that Ke Shi's incense offerings, land, and fields be abolished; Wei Jinzhong's record of merit on tomb works was entered—no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Censor Wang Xinyi memorialized to abolish Ke Shi's endowed incense lands and fields, and Wei Jinzhong's merit record for tomb construction was submitted for promotion—but the court gave no reply.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，言官請複當朝口奏及召對之典，從之。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiachen: remonstrance officials requested restoration of the rites of oral memorial at court and summoned audience; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiachen, remonstrance officials asked that the rites of oral memorial at court and summoned audience be restored; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 己未，御經筵。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: [the emperor] attended the Classics Lectern.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the emperor attended the Classics Lectern.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙酉，以風霾諭群臣修省。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day yiyou: because of wind haze, the assembled ministers were admonished to practice self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yiyou, a wind haze prompted an edict urging the ministers to practice self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，孫如游致仕。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Sun Ruyou retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Sun Ruyou retired from office.

sentences.zh: 丙申，除齊泰、黃子澄戚屬戍籍。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: relatives of Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng were removed from banishment registers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen relatives of Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng were restored from exile registers.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，昭和殿災。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the Zhaohua Hall burned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Zhaohua Hall was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，大清兵取瀋陽，總兵官尤世功、賀世賢戰死。

translations.literal: Third month, day yimao: Qing troops captured Shenyang; Regional Commanders You Shigong and He Shixian died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yimao, Qing forces captured Shenyang; Regional Commanders You Shigong and He Shixian died fighting.

sentences.zh: 總兵官陳策、童仲揆、戚金、張名世帥諸將援遼，戰於渾河，皆敗沒。

translations.literal: Regional Commanders Chen Ce, Tong Zhongkui, Qi Jin, and Zhang Mingshi led the generals to relieve Liaodong; they fought at the Hun River and were all defeated and lost.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commanders Chen Ce, Tong Zhongkui, Qi Jin, and Zhang Mingshi led relief forces into Liaodong, fought at the Hun River, and were all defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大清兵取遼陽，經略袁應泰等死之。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Qing troops captured Liaoyang; Commissioner-in-Chief Yuan Yingtai and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Qing forces captured Liaoyang, and Commissioner-in-Chief Yuan Yingtai and others died.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史張銓被執，不屈死。

translations.literal: Touring Censor Zhang Quan was captured; he refused submission and died.
translations.idiomatic: Touring Censor Zhang Quan was captured and, refusing to submit, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，諭兵部：「國家文武並用，頃承平日久，視武弁不啻奴隸，致令豪傑解體。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the Ministry of War was instructed: "The state employs both civil and military together; lately, after long peace, military officers are regarded as no better than slaves, causing champions to lose cohesion.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict addressed to the Ministry of War read: "The state has always used civil and military talent together; but after years of peace, military officers came to be treated like slaves, and brave men lost heart.

sentences.zh: 今邊疆多故，大風猛士深軫朕懷，其令有司於山林草澤間慎選將材。

translations.literal: Now the frontiers have many troubles; the shortage of fierce warriors weighs deeply on Our heart—let the officials carefully select general talent from among mountains, forests, grasslands, and marshes.
translations.idiomatic: Now the frontiers are troubled on many sides; the shortage of fierce warriors weighs deeply on Our heart—let officials carefully seek commanders among the hills, forests, and wild country.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: " Day dingmao: the capital was placed under martial law.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the capital was placed under martial alert.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renshen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renshen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，禁抄發軍機。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: copying and dissemination of military secrets was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the court forbade copying and leaking military intelligence.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遼東巡撫僉都御史薛國用為兵部侍郎，經略遼東。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Xue Guoyong, Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Liaodong, was made Vice Minister of War and commissioner-in-chief of Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Xue Guoyong, grand coordinator of Liaodong, was made vice minister of war and put in charge of Liaodong affairs.

sentences.zh: 參議王化貞為右僉都御史，巡撫廣寧。

translations.literal: Assistant Administer Wang Huazhen was made Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Administrator Wang Huazhen was made right assistant censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Guangning.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，募兵於通州、天津、宣府、大同。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: troops were recruited at Tongzhou, Tianjin, Xuanfu, and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the court began recruiting troops at Tongzhou, Tianjin, Xuanfu, and Datong.

sentences.zh: 甲午，募兵於陝西、河南、山西、浙江。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: troops were recruited in Shaanxi, Henan, Shanxi, and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu troops were recruited in Shaanxi, Henan, Shanxi, and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，冊皇后張氏。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Empress Zhang was invested.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Empress Zhang was invested.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，貴州紅苗平。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingwei: the Red Miao of Guizhou were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingwei, the Red Miao of Guizhou were pacified.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，禁訛言。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: slanderous rumors were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the court forbade the spreading of slanderous rumors.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，陝西都指揮陳愚直以固原兵入援，潰於臨洺。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Chen Yuzhi, Regional Commander of Shaanxi, led Guyuan troops to reinforce; they broke at Linming.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Chen Yuzhi, regional commander of Shaanxi, led Guyuan troops east to reinforce Liaodong, but they broke and fled at Linming.

sentences.zh: 未幾，寧夏援遼兵潰於三河。

translations.literal: Before long, Ningxia relief troops for Liaodong broke at Sanhe.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, Ningxia relief troops bound for Liaodong broke and fled at Sanhe.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，何宗彥入閣。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiyou: He Zongyan entered the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiyou, He Zongyan entered the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙子，硃國祚入閣。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Zhu Guozuo entered the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Zhu Guozuo entered the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 熊廷弼為兵部尚書兼右副都御史，經略遼東。

translations.literal: Xiong Tingbi was made Minister of War and concurrent Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, commissioner-in-chief of Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Tingbi was made minister of war and also right vice censor-in-chief, with overall charge of Liaodong affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，兵部尚書王像乾總督薊、遼軍務。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Wang Xiangqian, Minister of War, was made overall commander of military affairs in Ji and Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Wang Xiangqian, minister of war, was put in overall command of military affairs in Ji and Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，沈飀入閣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yisi: Shen Lü entered the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yisi, Shen Lü entered the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，擢參將毛文龍為副總兵，駐師鎮江城。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingzi: Assistant Regional Commander Mao Wenlong was promoted to Vice Regional Commander and garrisoned troops at Zhenjiang city.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingzi, Assistant Regional Commander Mao Wenlong was promoted to vice regional commander and stationed his force at Zhenjiang city.

sentences.zh: 戊子，杭州大火，詔停強造。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: a great fire struck Hangzhou; an edict halted forced construction.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi a great fire broke out in Hangzhou, and an edict halted forced labor construction projects.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，停刑。

translations.literal: Day guisi: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，葬貞皇帝於慶陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renyin: the Pure Emperor was buried at Qingling.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renyin, Emperor Guangzong was buried at Qingling.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，永寧宣撫使奢崇明反，殺巡撫徐可求，據重慶，分兵陷合江、納溪、瀘州。

translations.literal: Day yimao: She Chongming, Pacification Commissioner of Yongning, rebelled, killed Grand Coordinator Xu Keqiu, seized Chongqing, and sent separate forces to capture Hejiang, Naxi, and Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao She Chongming, pacification commissioner of Yongning, rose in rebellion, killed Grand Coordinator Xu Keqiu, seized Chongqing, and sent columns to capture Hejiang, Naxi, and Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，陷興文，知縣張振德死之。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Xingwen fell; Magistrate Zhang Zhende died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Xingwen fell, and Magistrate Zhang Zhende died defending it.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，御史周宗建請出客氏於外，不聽。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuchen: Censor Zhou Zongjian requested that Ke Shi be sent out of the palace; the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuchen, Censor Zhou Zongjian memorialized that Ke Shi be sent out of the palace, but the court did not listen.

sentences.zh: 給事中倪思輝、硃欽相等相繼言，皆謫外任。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretaries Ni Sihui, Zhu Qinxiang, and others spoke in succession; all were demoted to outside posts.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretaries Ni Sihui, Zhu Qinxiang, and others remonstrated in turn, and all were demoted to posts outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙子，史繼偕入閣。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Shi Jijie entered the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Shi Jijie entered the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，奢崇明圍成都，布政使硃燮元固守。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: She Chongming besieged Chengdu; Provincial Administer Zhu Suanyuan held firm.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou She Chongming besieged Chengdu, and Provincial Administrator Zhu Suanyuan held the city firm.

sentences.zh: 尋擢燮元僉都御史，巡撫四川。

translations.literal: Before long Zhu Suanyuan was promoted to Assistant Censor-in-Chief and made grand coordinator of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Zhu Suanyuan was promoted to assistant censor-in-chief and made grand coordinator of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 石砫宣撫使女土官秦良玉起兵討賊。

translations.literal: Qin Liangyu, female native-official of Shizhu, Pacification Commissioner, raised troops to attack the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Liangyu, the female native official of Shizhu pacification district, raised troops to campaign against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，葉向高入閣。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Ye Xianggao entered the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Ye Xianggao entered the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，巡撫河南都御史張我續為兵部侍郎，提督川、貴軍務。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingchou: Zhang Woxu, Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Henan, was made Vice Minister of War and put in overall charge of military affairs in Sichuan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingchou, Zhang Woxu, grand coordinator of Henan, was made vice minister of war and put in overall charge of military affairs in Sichuan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 陝西巡撫移駐漢中，鄖陽巡撫移駐夷陵。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator of Shaanxi moved his headquarters to Hanzhong; the grand coordinator of Yunyang moved his headquarters to Yiling.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator of Shaanxi shifted his headquarters to Hanzhong, and the grand coordinator of Yunyang shifted his to Yiling.

sentences.zh: 湖廣官軍由巫峽趨忠、涪討賊。

translations.literal: Huguang government troops advanced through the Wu Gorge toward Zhong and Fu to attack the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang government troops marched through the Wu Gorge toward Zhongzhou and Fuling to attack the rebels.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，援遼浙兵嘩於玉田。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Zhejiang relief troops for Liaodong mutinied at Yutian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Zhejiang relief troops bound for Liaodong mutinied at Yutian.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以熊廷弼、王化貞屢議戰守不合，遣使宣諭。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: because Xiong Tingbi and Wang Huazhen repeatedly disputed offense and defense without agreement, envoys were dispatched to proclaim the imperial will.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, because Xiong Tingbi and Wang Huazhen repeatedly clashed over strategy, the court dispatched envoys to convey the imperial will.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、土魯番、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annam, Turfan, and U-Tsang entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam, Turfan, and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁未，延綏總兵官杜文煥、四川總兵官楊愈懋討永寧賊。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day dingwei: Regional Commanders Du Wenhuan of Yansui and Yang Yumao of Sichuan campaigned against the Yongning rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianqi two, in the first month of spring, on dingwei, Regional Commanders Du Wenhuan of Yansui and Yang Yumao of Sichuan campaigned against the Yongning rebels.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大清兵取西平堡，副將羅一貴死之。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Qing troops captured Xiping Fort; Vice General Luo Yigui died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Qing forces captured Xiping Fort, and Vice General Luo Yigui died defending it.

sentences.zh: 鎮武營總兵官劉渠、祁秉忠逆戰於平陽橋，敗沒。

translations.literal: Regional Commanders Liu Qu and Qi Bingzhong of Zhenwu Camp fought the enemy at Pingyang Bridge and were defeated and lost.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commanders Liu Qu and Qi Bingzhong of Zhenwu Camp fought the enemy at Pingyang Bridge and were defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 王化貞走閭陽，與熊廷弼等俱入關。

translations.literal: Wang Huazhen fled to Lüyang; he and Xiong Tingbi and others all entered the pass.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Huazhen fled to Lüyang, and he and Xiong Tingbi and others all withdrew inside the frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 參政高邦佐留松山，死之。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner Gao Bangzuo remained at Songshan and died.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commissioner Gao Bangzuo remained to hold Songshan and died there.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，振山東流徙遼民。

translations.literal: Day renxu: displaced Liaodong people who had fled to Shandong were assisted.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu relief was extended to Liaodong refugees who had fled into Shandong.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，兵部尚書張鶴鳴視師遼東。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Zhang Heming, Minister of War, inspected the army in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhang Heming, minister of war, went to Liaodong to inspect the armies.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the capital was placed under martial law.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the capital was again placed under martial alert.

sentences.zh: 河套部犯延綏。

translations.literal: The Ordos tribes invaded Yansui.
translations.idiomatic: Ordos tribes raided Yansui.

sentences.zh: 永寧賊將羅乾象約降，與官軍共擊賊，成都圍解。

translations.literal: Luo Qianxiang, a Yongning rebel general, agreed to surrender; together with government troops he attacked the rebels, and the siege of Chengdu was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Qianxiang, a Yongning rebel general, agreed to defect and, fighting alongside government troops, helped break the siege of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，水西土同知安邦彥反，陷畢節、安順、平壩、沾益、龍里，遂圍貴陽，巡撫都御史李枟、巡按御史史永安固守。

translations.literal: Second month, day guiyou: Anbangyan, native vice prefect of Shuixi, rebelled, captured Bijie, Anshun, Pingba, Zhanyi, and Longli, then besieged Guiyang; Censor-in-Chief Li Zong, grand coordinator, and Touring Censor Shi Yongan held firm.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiyou, Anbangyan, native vice prefect of Shuixi, rebelled, overran Bijie, Anshun, Pingba, Zhanyi, and Longli, and then besieged Guiyang; Grand Coordinator Li Zong and Touring Censor Shi Yongan held the city firm.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，免天下帶徵錢糧二年及北畿加派。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: two years of supplementary tax levies throughout the realm and additional assessments in the northern capital region were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the court remitted two years of supplemental tax collections throughout the realm and additional levies in the northern capital region.

sentences.zh: 禮部右侍郎孫承宗為兵部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Sun Chengzong, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Minister of War and concurrent Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and took part in confidential state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Chengzong, vice minister of rites, was made minister of war and also grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, and admitted to confidential state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 己丑，孫承宗兼理兵部事。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Sun Chengzong also took charge of Ministry of War affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Sun Chengzong was also put in charge of Ministry of War affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉朔，劉一燝致仕。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingyou new moon: Liu Yipeng retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dingyou new moon, Liu Yipeng retired from office.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，陽武侯薛濂管理募兵。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Xue Lian, Marquis of Yangwu, was put in charge of recruiting troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Xue Lian, Marquis of Yangwu, was appointed to oversee troop recruitment.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎王在晉為尚書兼右副都御史，經略遼、薊、天津、登、萊軍務。

translations.literal: Wang Zaijin, Vice Minister of War, was made Minister and concurrent Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, commissioner-in-chief of military affairs in Liaodong, Ji, Tianjin, Deng, and Lai.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zaijin, vice minister of war, was promoted to minister and also right vice censor-in-chief, with overall charge of military affairs in Liaodong, Ji, Tianjin, Deng, and Lai.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賜文震孟等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and various degrees were granted to Wen Zhenmeng and others according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Wen Zhenmeng and others received jinshi titles and palace degrees according to merit.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，敕湖廣、雲南、廣西官軍援貴州。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: an imperial order commanded Huguang, Yunnan, and Guangxi government troops to reinforce Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi an imperial order directed Huguang, Yunnan, and Guangxi government troops to reinforce Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 是春，舉內操。

translations.literal: That spring, palace drill exercises were held.
translations.idiomatic: That spring the court conducted internal military drill exercises.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，京師旱。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: drought in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiashen, drought struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，复張居正原官。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuxu: Zhang Juzheng's original offices were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuxu, Zhang Juzheng's original offices were restored posthumously.

sentences.zh: 己亥，錄方孝孺遺嗣，尋予祭葬及諡。

translations.literal: Day jihai: surviving descendants of Fang Xiaoru were recorded; soon sacrificial honors, burial grants, and a posthumous title were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai surviving descendants of Fang Xiaoru were officially registered, and soon sacrificial honors, burial grants, and a posthumous title followed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，山東白蓮賊徐鴻儒反，陷鄆城。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Xu Hongru, White Lotus rebel of Shandong, rebelled and captured Yuncheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Xu Hongru, a White Lotus rebel in Shandong, rose in rebellion and captured Yuncheng.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，秦良玉、杜文煥破賊於佛圖關，官軍合圍重慶，復之。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Qin Liangyu and Du Wenhuan defeated the rebels at Fotu Pass; government troops combined to encircle Chongqing and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Qin Liangyu and Du Wenhuan routed the rebels at Fotu Pass, and government troops converged on Chongqing and recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，徐鴻儒陷鄒縣、滕縣，滕縣知縣姬文胤死之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuchen: Xu Hongru captured Zou county and Teng county; Magistrate Ji Wenyin of Teng county died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuchen, Xu Hongru captured Zou and Teng counties, and Ji Wenyin, magistrate of Teng county, died defending it.

sentences.zh: 加毛文龍為總兵官。

translations.literal: Mao Wenlong was promoted to Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Wenlong was promoted to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 貴州總兵官張彥芳為平蠻總兵官，從巡撫都御史王三善討水西賊。

translations.literal: Regional Commander of Guizhou Zhang Yanfang was made Pacification Commissioner and joined Grand Coordinator Wang Sanshan in campaigning against the Shuixi rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Zhang Yanfang of Guizhou was made pacification commissioner and joined Grand Coordinator Wang Sanshan in campaigning against the Shuixi rebels.

sentences.zh: 己巳，前總兵官楊肇基、游擊陳九德帥兵討山東賊。

translations.literal: Day jisi: former Regional Commander Yang Zhaoji and Guerrilla Commander Chen Jiude led troops against the Shandong rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi former Regional Commander Yang Zhaoji and Guerrilla Commander Chen Jiude led troops against the Shandong rebels.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，松潘副使李忠臣約總兵官楊愈懋謀复永寧，不克，皆死之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiachen: Vice Commissioner of Songpan Li Zhongchen joined Regional Commander Yang Yumei in plotting to recover Yongning; they failed and both died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiachen, Vice Commissioner Li Zhongchen of Songpan and Regional Commander Yang Yumei plotted to recover Yongning; they failed, and both died.

sentences.zh: 賊攻大壩，游擊龔萬祿戰死，遂陷遵義。

translations.literal: The rebels attacked Daba; Guerrilla Commander Gong Wanlu died in battle, and Zunyi fell.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels attacked Daba; Guerrilla Commander Gong Wanlu died fighting, and Zunyi fell.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，沈飀致仕。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Shen Liu retired.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Shen Liu retired from office.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，神宗神主祔太廟。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the spirit tablet of Shenzong was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the spirit tablet of Shenzong was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚申，援黔兵潰於新添。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: relief troops for Guizhou broke and fled at Xintian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen troops sent to relieve Guizhou broke and fled at Xintian.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，武邑賊於弘志作亂，尋伏誅。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the Wuyi rebel Yu Hongzhi rose in revolt and was soon executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Wuyi rebel Yu Hongzhi rose in revolt and was soon put to death.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，孫承宗以原官督理山海關及薊、遼、天津、登、萊軍務。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengchen: Sun Chengzong retained his original rank and took charge of military affairs at Shanhaiguan and in Ji, Liaodong, Tianjin, Deng, and Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengchen, Sun Chengzong retained his original rank and took charge of military affairs at Shanhaiguan and in Ji, Liaodong, Tianjin, Deng, and Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午朔，光宗神主祔太廟。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu new moon: the spirit tablet of Guangzong was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiawu new moon, the spirit tablet of Guangzong was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，御史馮英請設州縣兵，按畝供餉，從之。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Censor Feng Ying requested that prefecture and county militia be established with supplies levied per mu of land; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Censor Feng Ying requested that militia be established in prefectures and counties with supplies levied per mu of land, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，封皇弟由檢為信王。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the emperor's younger brother Youjian was enfeoffed as Prince of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the emperor's younger brother Zhu Youjian was enfeoffed as Prince of Xin.

sentences.zh: 停刑。

translations.literal: Executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，水西賊犯雲南，官軍擊敗之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinwei: Shuixi rebels raided Yunnan and were defeated by government troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinwei, Shuixi rebels raided Yunnan and were defeated by government troops.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，官軍复鄒縣，擒徐鴻儒等，山東賊平。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: government troops recovered Zou County, captured Xu Hongru and others, and the Shandong rebellion was suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi government troops recovered Zou County, captured Xu Hongru and others, and the Shandong rebellion was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，總兵官魯欽代杜文煥為總理，援貴州。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Regional Commander Lu Qin replaced Du Wenhuan as overall commander and marched to relieve Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Regional Commander Lu Qin replaced Du Wenhuan as overall commander and marched to relieve Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，硃燮元總督四川軍務。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou: Zhu Xieyuan was made grand coordinator of Sichuan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guichou, Zhu Xieyuan was made grand coordinator of Sichuan military affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳，王三善、副總兵劉超敗賊於龍里，貴陽圍解。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jisi: Wang Sanshan and Vice Regional Commander Liu Chao defeated the rebels at Longli and lifted the siege of Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jisi, Wang Sanshan and Vice Regional Commander Liu Chao defeated the rebels at Longli and lifted the siege of Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Siam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己酉，禮部侍郎硃國禎，尚書顧秉謙，侍郎硃延禧、魏廣微，俱禮部尚書東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day jiyou: Vice Minister of Rites Zhu Guozhen, Minister Gu Bingqian, and Vice Ministers Zhu Yanxi and Wei Guangwei were all made grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion with the rank of minister of rites and participated in affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Tianqi three, on jiyou of the first month, Vice Minister of Rites Zhu Guozhen, Minister Gu Bingqian, and Vice Ministers Zhu Yanxi and Wei Guangwei were all made grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion with the rank of minister of rites and joined in affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，紅夷據澎湖。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the Red Barbarians occupied the Pescadores.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Red Barbarians occupied the Pescadores.

sentences.zh: 貴州官軍三路進討水西，副總兵劉超敗績於陸廣河。

translations.literal: Guizhou government troops advanced against Shuixi on three routes; Vice Regional Commander Liu Chao was defeated at Luguang River.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou government troops advanced against Shuixi on three routes, but Vice Regional Commander Liu Chao was defeated at Luguang River.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，贈卹鄒縣死難博士孟承光及母孔氏，子弘略。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiyou: posthumous honors were granted to the licentiate Meng Chengguang, who died defending Zou County, and to his mother, Lady Kong, and son Honglue.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiyou, posthumous honors were granted to the licentiate Meng Chengguang, who had died defending Zou County, and to his mother Lady Kong and his son Honglue.

sentences.zh: 是月，停南京進鮮。

translations.literal: That month deliveries of fresh produce to Nanjing were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: That month deliveries of fresh produce to Nanjing were suspended.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，朝鮮廢其主李琿。

translations.literal: Third month, day guimao: Korea deposed its ruler Li Hun.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guimao, Korea deposed its ruler Li Hun.

sentences.zh: 是春，振山東被兵州縣。

translations.literal: That spring relief was sent to Shandong prefectures and counties ravaged by war.
translations.idiomatic: That spring relief was sent to Shandong prefectures and counties ravaged by war.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申朔，京師地震。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengshen new moon: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengshen new moon, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己巳，硃國祚致仕。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Zhu Guozuo retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zhu Guozuo retired from office.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，四川官軍敗賊於永寧，奢崇明走紅崖。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinchou: Sichuan government troops defeated the rebels at Yongning; She Chongming fled to Hongya.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinchou, Sichuan government troops defeated the rebels at Yongning, and She Chongming fled to Hongya.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，南京大內災。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinmao: the Nanjing Imperial Palace suffered a fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinmao, the Nanjing Imperial Palace suffered a fire.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，奢崇明走龍場，與安邦彥合。

translations.literal: Day renchen: She Chongming fled to Longchang and joined forces with An Bangyan.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen She Chongming fled to Longchang and joined forces with An Bangyan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，安南寇廣西，巡撫都御史何士晉禦卻之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Annam raided Guangxi; Grand Coordinator He Shijin drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Annam raided Guangxi, and Grand Coordinator He Shijin drove the invaders back.

sentences.zh: 己亥，史繼偕致仕。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Shi Jixie retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Shi Jixie retired from office.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，給事中陳良訓疏陳防微四事，下鎮撫司獄。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guisi: Supervising Secretary Chen Liangxun memorialized on four matters of preventive vigilance and was imprisoned by the Brocade Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guisi, Supervising Secretary Chen Liangxun memorialized on four matters of preventive vigilance and was imprisoned by the Brocade Guard.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，京師地震。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yihai: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yihai, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，停刑。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬寅，以皇子生，詔赦天下。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day renyin: because a prince had been born, an edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renyin, because a prince had been born, an edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 是月，王三善剿水西，屢破賊，至大方。

translations.literal: That month Wang Sanshan suppressed Shuixi, repeatedly defeated the rebels, and advanced as far as Dafang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wang Sanshan suppressed Shuixi, repeatedly defeated the rebels, and advanced as far as Dafang.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳朔，祀天於南郊。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingsi new moon: Heaven was sacrificed to at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the dingsi new moon, Heaven was sacrificed to at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，封李倧為朝鮮國王。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guisi: Li Zong was enfeoffed as king of Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guisi, Li Zong was enfeoffed as king of Korea.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，魏忠賢總督東廠。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Wei Zhongxian was made director-general of the Eastern Depot.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Wei Zhongxian was made director-general of the Eastern Depot.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Siam and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Siam and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙辰朔，長興民吳野樵殺知縣石有恆、主簿徐可行，尋伏誅。

translations.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day bingchen new moon: the Changxing commoner Wu Yeqiao killed Magistrate Shi Youheng and Clerk Xu Kexing and was soon executed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Tianqi four, on the bingchen new moon of the first month, the Changxing commoner Wu Yeqiao killed Magistrate Shi Youheng and Clerk Xu Kexing and was soon put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，王三善自大方旋師遇伏，被執死之，諸官將皆死。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Wang Sanshan, withdrawing from Dafang, fell into an ambush, was captured and killed, and all his officers and generals died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Wang Sanshan, withdrawing from Dafang, fell into an ambush, was captured and killed, and all his officers and generals died with him.

sentences.zh: 庚午，何宗彥卒。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: He Zongyan died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu He Zongyan died.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，薊州、永平、山海關地震，壞城郭廬舍。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingyou: Ji Prefecture, Yongping, and Shanhaiguan were shaken by earthquakes that damaged walls and buildings.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingyou, Ji Prefecture, Yongping, and Shanhaiguan were shaken by earthquakes that damaged city walls and buildings.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，京師地震，宮殿動搖有聲。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the capital was shaken by an earthquake; the palace buildings swayed with audible tremors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the capital was shaken by an earthquake, and the palace buildings swayed with audible tremors.

sentences.zh: 帝不豫。

translations.literal: The emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，疾愈。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingsi: he recovered from his illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingsi, he recovered from his illness.

sentences.zh: 庚申，杭州兵變。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: there was a mutiny among the troops at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the troops at Hangzhou mutinied.

sentences.zh: 是月，京師屢地震。

translations.literal: That month the capital was repeatedly shaken by earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: That month the capital was repeatedly shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲寅朔，福寧兵變，有司撫定之。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day jiayin new moon: there was a mutiny among the troops at Funing; the local authorities pacified it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the jiayin new moon, the troops at Funing mutinied, and the local authorities pacified them.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，左副都御史楊漣劾魏忠賢二十四大罪，南北諸臣論忠賢者相繼，皆不納。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiwei: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief Yang Lian impeached Wei Zhongxian on twenty-four great crimes; officials north and south memorialized against Zhongxian in succession, but none was accepted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiwei, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief Yang Lian impeached Wei Zhongxian on twenty-four great crimes; officials north and south memorialized against Zhongxian in succession, but none of their remonstrances was accepted.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大雨雹。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: there was heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen heavy hail fell.

sentences.zh: 杖殺工部郎中萬燝，逮杖御史林汝翥。

translations.literal: Director Wan Zhang of the Ministry of Works was beaten to death, and Censor Lin Rushu was arrested and beaten.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Zhang, director in the Ministry of Works, was beaten to death, and Censor Lin Rushu was arrested and beaten.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，葉向高致仕。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinyou: Ye Xianggao retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou, Ye Xianggao retired from office.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，河決徐州。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the Yellow River burst its banks at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Yellow River burst its banks at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 振山東飢。

translations.literal: Relief was sent to the hungry in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was sent to the hungry in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，削吏部侍郎陳於廷、副都御史楊漣、僉都御史左光斗籍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Vice Minister of Personnel Chen Yuting, Vice Censor-in-Chief Yang Lian, and Assistant Censor-in-Chief Zuo Guangdou were struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Vice Minister of Personnel Chen Yuting, Vice Censor-in-Chief Yang Lian, and Assistant Censor-in-Chief Zuo Guangdou were struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，韓爌致仕。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jisi: Han Kuang retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jisi, Han Kuang retired from office.

sentences.zh: 是月，貴州官兵敗賊於普定，進至織金，破之。

translations.literal: That month Guizhou government troops defeated rebels at Puding, advanced to Zhijin, and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: That month Guizhou government troops defeated rebels at Puding, advanced to Zhijin, and broke them.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，逮內閣中書汪文言下鎮撫司獄。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinsi: Grand Secretariat clerk Wang Wuyan was arrested and imprisoned by the Brocade Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinsi, Grand Secretariat clerk Wang Wuyan was arrested and imprisoned by the Brocade Guard.

sentences.zh: 丙申，硃國禎致仕。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Zhu Guozhen retired.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhu Guozhen retired from office.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，南京地震如雷。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake like thunder.

sentences.zh: 是月，兩當民變，殺知縣牛得用。

translations.literal: That month the people of Liangdang rose in revolt and killed Magistrate Niu Deyong.
translations.idiomatic: That month the people of Liangdang rose in revolt and killed Magistrate Niu Deyong.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸亥，大清兵取旅順。

translations.literal: Year five, spring, first month, day guihai: Qing forces took Lüshun.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Tianqi five, on guihai of the first month, Qing forces took Lüshun.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以慶陵工成，予魏忠賢等廕賚。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: because the Qingling Mausoleum project had been completed, Wei Zhongxian and others received hereditary honors and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, because the Qingling Mausoleum project had been completed, Wei Zhongxian and others received hereditary honors and rewards.

sentences.zh: 是月，總理魯欽、劉超等自織金旋師，為賊所襲，諸營兵潰。

translations.literal: That month Overall Commander Lu Qin, Liu Chao, and others withdrew from Zhijin; they were ambushed by rebels and the troops of all camps broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: That month Overall Commander Lu Qin, Liu Chao, and others withdrew from Zhijin, were ambushed by rebels, and the troops of all camps broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiayin:
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiayin,

sentences.zh: 釋奠於先師孔子。

translations.literal: Sacrifice was offered to Confucius, the supreme sage and teacher.
translations.idiomatic: sacrifice was offered to Confucius, the supreme sage and teacher.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賜餘煌等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Yu Huang and others were granted jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and various provincial degrees according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Yu Huang and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，硃燮元總督雲、貴、川、湖、廣西軍務，討安邦彥。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Zhu Xieyuan was made grand coordinator of military affairs in Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, Huguang, and Guangxi to campaign against An Bangyan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Zhu Xieyuan was made grand coordinator of military affairs in Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, Huguang, and Guangxi to campaign against An Bangyan.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，讞汪文言獄，逮楊漣、左光斗、袁化中、魏大中、周朝瑞、顧大章，削尚書趙南星等籍。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the case of Wang Wuyan was decided; Yang Lian, Zuo Guangdou, Yuan Huazhong, Wei Dazhong, Zhou Chaorui, and Gu Dazhang were arrested, and Minister Zhao Nanxing and others were struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the case of Wang Wuyan was decided; Yang Lian, Zuo Guangdou, Yuan Huazhong, Wei Dazhong, Zhou Chaorui, and Gu Dazhang were arrested, and Minister Zhao Nanxing and others were struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 未幾，漣等逮至，下鎮撫司獄，相繼死獄中。

translations.literal: Before long Yang Lian and the others were brought to the capital, imprisoned by the Brocade Guard, and died in succession in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yang Lian and the others were brought to the capital, imprisoned by the Brocade Guard, and died one after another in prison.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，削大學士劉一燝籍。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jihai: Grand Secretary Liu Yijin was struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jihai, Grand Secretary Liu Yijin was struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，給事中楊所修請以「梃擊」、「紅丸」、「移宮」三案編次成書，從之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guihai: Supervising Secretary Yang Suoxiu requested that the three cases—the Club Assault, the Red Pill, and the Palace Transfer—be compiled into a book; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guihai, Supervising Secretary Yang Suoxiu requested that the three cases—the Club Assault, the Red Pill, and the Palace Transfer—be compiled into a book, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，祀地於北郊。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Earth was sacrificed to at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Earth was sacrificed to at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚午，行宗室限錄法。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the restricted enrollment law for the imperial clan was put into effect.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the restricted enrollment law for the imperial clan was put into effect.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，硃延禧致仕。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingxu: Zhu Yanxi retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingxu, Zhu Yanxi retired from office.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，毀首善書院。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renxu: the Shoushan Academy was demolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renxu, the Shoushan Academy was demolished.

sentences.zh: 壬申，韓爌削籍。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Han Kuang was struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Han Kuang was struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，追論萬曆辛亥、丁巳、癸亥三京察，尚書李三才、顧憲成等削籍。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the three Beijing personnel evaluations of Wanli's xinhai, dingsi, and guihai years were reconsidered; Ministers Li Sancai, Gu Xiancheng, and others were struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the three Beijing personnel evaluations of Wanli's xinhai, dingsi, and guihai years were reconsidered, and Ministers Li Sancai, Gu Xiancheng, and others were struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，毀天下東林講學書院。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renwu: Donglin lecture academies throughout the realm were demolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renwu, Donglin lecture academies throughout the realm were demolished.

sentences.zh: 削尚書孫慎行等籍。

translations.literal: Minister Sun Shenxing and others were struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Sun Shenxing and others were struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禮部尚書周如磐兼東閣大學士，侍郎丁紹軾、黃立極為禮部尚書，少詹事馮銓為禮部右侍郎，並兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Minister of Rites Zhou Rupan was also made grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion; Vice Ministers Ding Shaoshi and Huang Liji were made ministers of rites; Junior Mentor Feng Quan was made right vice minister of rites; all also served as grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion and participated in affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Minister of Rites Zhou Rupan was also made grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion; Vice Ministers Ding Shaoshi and Huang Liji were made ministers of rites; Junior Mentor Feng Quan was made right vice minister of rites; and all three also served as grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion and joined in affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 己亥，魏廣微罷。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Wei Guangwei was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Wei Guangwei was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，熊廷弼棄市，傳首九邊。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Xiong Tingbi was executed by decapitation in the public market; his head was sent to the nine border regions.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Xiong Tingbi was executed in the public market, and his head was sent to the nine border regions.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，遼東副總兵魯之甲敗沒於柳河。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renzi: Liaodong Vice Regional Commander Lu Zhijia was defeated and perished at Liuhe.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi, Liaodong Vice Regional Commander Lu Zhijia was defeated and perished at Liuhe.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，兵部尚書高第經略遼、薊、登、萊、天津軍務。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jimao: Minister of War Gao Di was made commissioner for Liaodong, Ji, Deng, Laizhou, and Tianjin military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jimao, Minister of War Gao Di was made commissioner for Liaodong, Ji, Deng, Laizhou, and Tianjin military affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，停刑。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，孫承宗致仕。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Sun Chengzong retired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Sun Chengzong retired from office.

sentences.zh: 丙申，逮中書舍人吳懷賢下鎮撫司獄，杖殺之。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Secretariat drafter Wu Huaixian was arrested, imprisoned by the Brocade Guard, and beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Secretariat drafter Wu Huaixian was arrested, imprisoned by the Brocade Guard, and beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以皇子生，詔赦天下。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: because a prince had been born, an edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, because a prince had been born, an edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，周如磐致仕。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renzi: Zhou Rupan retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renzi, Zhou Rupan retired from office.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，榜東林黨人姓名，頒示天下。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiyou: the names of Donglin faction members were posted and promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiyou, the names of Donglin faction members were posted and promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 戊子，戍前尚書趙南星。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: former Minister Zhao Nanxing was banished to frontier service.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi former Minister Zhao Nanxing was banished to frontier service.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月戊午，修《三朝要典》。

translations.literal: Year six, spring, first month, day wuwu: compilation of the Essentials of Three Reigns was undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Tianqi six, on wuwu of the first month, compilation of the Essentials of Three Reigns was undertaken.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大清兵圍寧遠，總兵官滿桂、寧前道參政袁崇煥固守。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Qing forces besieged Ningyuan; Regional Commander Man Gui and Ningqian Circuit Administrator Yuan Chonghuan held firm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Qing forces besieged Ningyuan; Regional Commander Man Gui and Ningqian Circuit Administrator Yuan Chonghuan held firm.

sentences.zh: 己巳，圍解。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，袁崇煥為僉都御史，專理軍務，仍駐寧遠。

translations.literal: Second month, day yihai: Yuan Chonghuan was made Assistant Censor-in-Chief, put exclusively in charge of military affairs, and continued to be stationed at Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yihai, Yuan Chonghuan was made assistant censor-in-chief with exclusive charge of military affairs and remained stationed at Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以蘇杭織造太監李實奏，逮前應天巡撫週起元，吏部主事周順昌，左都御史高攀龍，諭德繆昌期，御史李應升、周宗建、黃尊素。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: on memorial of the Suzhou-Hangzhou Weaving Commissioner eunuch Li Shi, the former Governor of Yingtian Zhou Qiyuan, Principal Secretary in the Ministry of Personnel Zhou Shunchang, Left Censor-in-Chief Gao Panlong, Preceptor Miao Changqi, and Censors Li Yingsheng, Zhou Zongjian, and Huang Zunsu were arrested.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, on the petition of Suzhou-Hangzhou weaving commissioner eunuch Li Shi, former Yingtian governor Zhou Qiyuan, principal secretary in the Ministry of Personnel Zhou Shunchang, left censor-in-chief Gao Panlong, preceptor Miao Changqi, and censors Li Yingsheng, Zhou Zongjian, and Huang Zunsu were arrested.

sentences.zh: 攀龍赴水死，起元等下鎮撫司獄，相繼死獄中。

translations.literal: Panlong drowned himself; Qiyuan and the others were sent to Brook of Purification prison and one after another died in custody.
translations.idiomatic: Panlong drowned himself; Qiyuan and the others were cast into the Brook of Purification prison and died there one after another.

sentences.zh: 己亥。

translations.literal: Day jihai.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai.

sentences.zh: 祭日於東郊。

translations.literal: The sun was sacrificed to at the Eastern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: The court performed the suburban sacrifice to the sun at the eastern altar.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，設各邊鎮監軍內臣。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingwei: eunuch officials were appointed to supervise armies at the various frontier garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingwei, eunuch officials were posted to supervise troops at the frontier garrisons.

sentences.zh: 太監劉應坤鎮守山海關，大學士丁紹軾、兵部尚書王永光等屢諫不聽。

translations.literal: The eunuch Liu Yingkun was stationed at Shanhaiguan; Grand Secretaries Ding Shaozhi, Minister of War Wang Yongguang, and others repeatedly remonstrated but were not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Liu Yingkun was put in charge at Shanhaiguan; grand secretaries Ding Shaozhi and minister of war Wang Yongguang repeatedly remonstrated, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 論寧遠解圍功，封魏忠賢從子良卿肅寧伯。

translations.literal: For merit in relieving the siege of Ningyuan, Wei Zhongxian's nephew by a collateral line Liangqing was enfeoffed as Earl of Sunning.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in breaking the siege of Ningyuan, Wei Zhongxian's collateral nephew Liangqing was enfeoffed as Earl of Sunning.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，安邦彥犯貴州，官軍敗績，總理魯欽死之。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: An Bangyan invaded Guizhou; government troops were defeated; Supervisor-General Lu Qin died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu An Bangyan invaded Guizhou; government troops suffered defeat, and supervisor-general Lu Qin was killed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，袁崇煥巡撫遼東、山海。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Yuan Chonghuan was made Governor of Liaodong and Shanhai.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yuan Chonghuan was appointed governor of Liaodong and Shanhai.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，命南京守備內臣搜括應天各府貯庫銀，充殿工、兵餉。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingchou: the Nanjing garrison eunuch was ordered to requisition stored silver from the treasuries of the various prefectures of Yingtian to fund palace construction and military pay.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingchou, the Nanjing garrison eunuch was ordered to seize stored silver from Yingtian prefectures to pay for palace works and military supplies.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，丁紹軾卒。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Ding Shaozhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Ding Shaozhi died.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，王恭廠災，死者甚眾。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wushen: disaster struck the Wanggongchang Arsenal; very many died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wushen, the Wanggongchang gunpowder works exploded; the dead were very numerous.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以旱災敕群臣修省。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: because of drought disaster, the assembled ministers were ordered to practice self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, because of drought, the assembled ministers were instructed to examine themselves and reform their conduct.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，朝天宮災。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the Chaotian Palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Chaotian Palace was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，京師地震，靈丘地震經月。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingzi: the capital region shook with earthquake; Lingqiu quaked for a month.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingzi, the capital shook with an earthquake; Lingqiu trembled for a full month.

sentences.zh: 壬午，河決廣武。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the Yellow River burst its banks at Guangwu.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Yellow River broke through at Guangwu.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，《三朝要典》成，刊布中外。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the Three Dynasties Essentials was completed and published throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Three Dynasties Essentials was completed and circulated at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛丑，巡撫浙江僉都御史潘汝楨請建魏忠賢生祠，許之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day xinchou: Pan Ruzhen, Assistant Censor-in-Chief and Governor of Zhejiang, requested construction of a living shrine to Wei Zhongxian; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on xinchou, Zhejiang governor Pan Ruzhen, an assistant censor-in-chief, requested that a living shrine to Wei Zhongxian be built; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 嗣是建祠幾遍天下。

translations.literal: From this time living shrines were built nearly everywhere under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: From that time on, such shrines sprang up nearly everywhere in the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，馮銓罷。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Feng Quan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Feng Quan was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬子，硃燮元以憂去，偏沅巡撫都御史閔夢得代之。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Zhu Xieyuan left office on mourning; Governor and Censor-in-Chief of Pian-Yuan Min Mengde replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Zhu Xieyuan left office to observe mourning, and Pian-Yuan governor and censor-in-chief Min Mengde took his place.

sentences.zh: 是夏，京師大水，江北、山東旱蝗。

translations.literal: That summer the capital region suffered great floods; north of the Yangzi and Shandong suffered drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the capital region was ravaged by floods, while lands north of the Yangzi and Shandong were stricken with drought and locusts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未朔，日當食，陰雲不見。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinwei new moon: an eclipse was due; clouds obscured it from view.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinwei new moon, a solar eclipse was expected, but clouds hid it from sight.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，下前揚州知府劉鐸詔獄，殺之。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the former Prefect of Yangzhou Liu Duo was sent to the imperial prison on imperial order and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi former Yangzhou prefect Liu Duo was cast into the imperial prison by edict and put to death.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，禮部侍郎施鳳來、張瑞圖，詹事李國𣚴，俱禮部尚書東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Vice Ministers of Rites Shi Fenglai and Zhang Ruitu and Grand Mentor Li Guozhen were all made Ministers of Rites, Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Lodge, and entered deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu vice ministers of rites Shi Fenglai and Zhang Ruitu and grand mentor Li Guozhen were all made ministers of rites, grand secretaries of the Eastern Lodge, and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 八月，陝西流賊起，由保寧犯廣元。

translations.literal: Eighth month: bandit rebels arose in Shaanxi; from Baoning they invaded Guangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month bandits rose in Shaanxi and, moving from Baoning, raided Guangyuan.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，顧秉謙致仕。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: Gu Bingqian retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengyin, Gu Bingqian retired from office.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，皇極殿成，停刑。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the Huangji Hall was completed; executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the Huangji Hall was completed, and executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 己亥，魏良卿進封肅寧侯。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Wei Liangqing was further enfeoffed as Marquis of Sunning.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Wei Liangqing was promoted to Marquis of Sunning.

sentences.zh: 是月，參將楊明輝齎敕招諭水西賊，被殺。

translations.literal: That month Assistant Regional Commander Yang Minghui bore an imperial edict to summon and instruct the bandits of Shuixi and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: That month assistant regional commander Yang Minghui was sent with an imperial edict to summon the Shuixi bandits to surrender and was killed.

sentences.zh: 是秋，江北大水，河南蝗。

translations.literal: That autumn the lands north of the Yangzi suffered great floods; Henan suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the north of the Yangzi was inundated, and Henan was plagued by locusts.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，進魏忠賢爵上公，魏良卿寧國公，予誥券，加賜莊田一千頃。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wushen: Wei Zhongxian's rank was advanced to Supreme Duke; Wei Liangqing was made Duke of Ning; patents were granted; and an additional one thousand qing of estate lands were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen, Wei Zhongxian was promoted to supreme duke; Wei Liangqing was made Duke of Ning; patents of nobility were granted; and an additional thousand qing of estate lands were bestowed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以皇極殿成詔天下，官匠雜流升授者九百六十五人。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: because the Huangji Hall was completed, an edict was issued to the realm; nine hundred sixty-five artisan and miscellaneous personnel received promotions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, with the completion of the Huangji Hall, an edict went out to the realm promoting nine hundred sixty-five artisan and miscellaneous officials.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，改修《光宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the Veritable Records of Emperor Guangzong were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the Veritable Records of Emperor Guangzong were ordered revised.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，予魏良卿鐵券。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengyin: an iron patent was granted to Wei Liangqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin, an iron patent of nobility was granted to Wei Liangqing.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，南京地震。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: Nanjing shook with earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wushen, Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲子，潯州賊殺守備蔡人龍。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: bandits of Xunzhou killed Garrison Commander Cai Renlong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi bandits in Xunzhou killed garrison commander Cai Renlong.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、烏斯藏、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Annam, U-Tsang, and Ryukyu entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam, U-Tsang, and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月辛未，振鳳陽飢。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, day xinwei: famine relief was provided to the hungry at Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, in the first month of spring, on xinwei, famine relief was sent to the hungry at Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太監塗文輔總督太倉銀庫、節慎庫，崔文升、李明道提督漕運河道，核京師、通州諸倉。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the eunuch Tu Wenfu was put in overall charge of the Taicang Silver Treasury and the Jieshen Treasury; Cui Wensheng and Li Mingdao were put in charge of the Grand Canal transport routes and inspected the granaries of the capital region and Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai eunuch Tu Wenfu was made overall supervisor of the Taicang and Jieshen treasuries; Cui Wensheng and Li Mingdao were put in charge of the Grand Canal and ordered to audit the granaries of the capital and Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，免榷潼關、咸陽商稅。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: commercial taxes at Tongguan and Xianyang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao commercial taxes at Tongguan and Xianyang were remitted.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，修隆德殿。

translations.literal: Second month, day renxu: the Longde Hall was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu, the Longde Hall was repaired.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，豐城侯李承祚請開採珠池、銅礦，不許。

translations.literal: Third month, day guiyou: Li Chengzuo, Marquis of Fengcheng, requested opening pearl beds and copper mines; permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou, Li Chengzuo, marquis of Fengcheng, asked to open pearl beds and copper mines, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 戊子，澄城民變，殺知縣張斗耀。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the people of Chengcheng rose in mutiny and killed Magistrate Zhang Douyao.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the people of Chengcheng mutinied and killed magistrate Zhang Douyao.

sentences.zh: 是春，大清兵征朝鮮。

translations.literal: That spring Qing troops campaigned against Korea.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Qing forces invaded Korea.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，下前侍郎王之寀鎮撫司獄，死獄中。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingyou: the former Vice Minister Wang Zhicai was sent to Brook of Purification prison and died in custody.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingyou, former vice minister Wang Zhicai was cast into the Brook of Purification prison and died there.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，監生陸萬齡請建魏忠賢生祠於太學旁，祀禮如孔子，許之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jisi: the Supervising Student Lu Wanling requested construction beside the Imperial Academy of a living shrine to Wei Zhongxian with rites of worship equal to Confucius; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jisi, supervising student Lu Wanling asked to build beside the Imperial Academy a living shrine to Wei Zhongxian with rites modeled on those for Confucius; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大清兵圍錦州。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Qing troops besieged Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Qing troops besieged Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，攻寧遠。

translations.literal: Day guisi: they attacked Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi they attacked Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，錦州圍解。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengzi: the siege of Jinzhou was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengzi, the siege of Jinzhou was lifted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑朔，帝不豫。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yichou new moon: the Emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yichou new moon, the emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，罷袁崇煥。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Yuan Chonghuan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Yuan Chonghuan was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 己卯，封魏忠賢孫鵬翼為安平伯。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Wei Zhongxian's grandson Pengyi was enfeoffed as Earl of Anping.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Wei Zhongxian's grandson Pengyi was enfeoffed as Earl of Anping.

sentences.zh: 壬午，戍孫慎行。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Sun Shenxing was banished to frontier service.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Sun Shenxing was banished to frontier garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，海賊寇廣東。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: sea bandits raided Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai sea bandits raided Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 是月，浙江大水。

translations.literal: That month Zhejiang suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhejiang was devastated by floods.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，加魏良卿太師，魏鵬翼少師。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingshen: Wei Liangqing was additionally made Grand Preceptor; Wei Pengyi was made Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingshen, Wei Liangqing was further made grand preceptor and Wei Pengyi junior preceptor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，中極、建極二殿成。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the Zhongji and Jianji Halls were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Zhongji and Jianji Halls were completed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，召見閣部、科道諸臣於乾清宮，諭以魏忠賢、王體乾忠貞可計大事。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the ministers of the Grand Secretariat and censorate officials were summoned to the Qianqing Palace and instructed that Wei Zhongxian and Wang Tigān were loyal and could be entrusted with great affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi ministers of the Grand Secretariat and censorate officials were summoned to the Qianqing Palace and told that Wei Zhongxian and Wang Tigān were loyal and fit to be relied on for weighty affairs.

sentences.zh: 封忠賢侄良棟為東安侯。

translations.literal: Zhongxian's nephew Liangdong was enfeoffed as Marquis of Dong'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxian's nephew Liangdong was enfeoffed as Marquis of Dong'an.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大漸。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the Emperor grew gravely ill.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the emperor sank into critical illness.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，崩於乾清宮，年二十三。

translations.literal: Day yimao: he died at the Qianqing Palace, aged twenty-three.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he died in the Qianqing Palace at the age of twenty-three.

sentences.zh: 遺詔以皇第五弟信王由檢嗣皇帝位。

translations.literal: The testamentary edict named the Emperor's fifth younger brother, Prince Xin Zhu Youjian, to succeed to the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: The testamentary edict named the emperor's fifth younger brother, Prince Xin Zhu Youjian, to succeed to the throne.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，上尊諡，廟號熹宗，葬德陵。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengzi: elevated posthumous title and temple name Xizong were bestowed; he was buried at Deling.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengzi, elevated posthumous honors were granted and the temple name Xizong conferred; he was buried at Deling.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：明自世宗而後，綱紀日以陵夷，神宗末年，廢壞極矣。

translations.literal: Appraisal: From the time of Shizong onward, Ming institutions daily declined; by the late years of Shenzong, decay had reached its extreme.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: From Shizong's reign onward, the institutions of the Ming daily declined, and by Shenzong's final years ruin was complete.

sentences.zh: 雖有剛明英武之君，已難復振。

translations.literal: Even had there been a firm, clear-sighted, and martial ruler, revival would already have been difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Even a firm, clear-sighted, and martial sovereign could scarcely have revived them.

sentences.zh: 而重以帝之庸懦，婦寺竊柄，濫賞淫刑，忠良慘禍，億兆離心，雖慾不亡，何可得哉？

translations.literal: Yet compounded by this Emperor's weakness and timidity, with consorts and eunuchs usurping power, indiscriminate rewards and excessive punishments, loyal officials suffering grievous calamity, and the multitudes turning away in heart—even if one did not wish extinction, how could it be avoided?
translations.idiomatic: Compounded by this emperor's feebleness and timidity, with consorts and eunuchs seizing power, rewards poured out without measure and punishments ran wild, loyal men met cruel ends, and the people turned away in their hearts—even if one did not seek ruin, how could it have been avoided?
